real_row_pipeline_replay.note: Every 64th fitting representative within each real entity bucket/route; original public observations, actions and old targets. This is a bounded fitting replay, not a complete-cycle measurement. Historical optimizer/simulator state was not resumed.

methodology.primary_evidence: Read-only logs, hardware samples and public trajectory arrays from runs/compact-stages-101/easy/interrupted.zip; old v2 protocol, no autonomous/optimizer resume.
methodology.pipeline_replay: Shared CompleteGameBuffer, FittingSpool, BatchPrefetch and batch_loss. Sample every 64th already-compacted representative separately within each real width bucket/route, retaining original actions, observations and targets. Fresh temporary Adam/EMA, four commits per repetition, transport 2048, two repetitions per setting; first is cold, second is warm. No trained weights saved.
methodology.compaction: Shared compact_invalid_rows on slim copies of all original metadata including inactive slots, reset/done boundaries and original file order. Slim-metadata timing excludes archive reads and full spool construction.
methodology.synthetic_controls: Shared fit_benchmark.measure, WORKLOAD_WIDTHS sparse=(8,), medium=(64,), dense=(256,), 128 rows per width; baseline four action mixes, candidate accepted-only widths64/256, three warm repetitions after one cold four-pass cycle. Current auto 4070 profile; no CLI batch_size clamp.
methodology.profiling: One warmed 128-row,64-entity accepted batch loss/backward/master accumulation, plus two actual collector calls following a 64-step current-code initial-state collection probe. Profiler overhead excluded from throughput measurements.
methodology.limits: Historical training was interrupted in pass1. Replay is sampled and has no simulator allocation or live viewer. No complete current-contract 128-game cycle, independent process A/B randomization, sustained thermal run, or speedup in game performance was measured.

transport_capacity_probe.note: Nine prefetch constructions of the same 64-entity spool; capacity is independent of actual width. Two entity arrays of 2048x256x11 int32 reserve 44MiB alone. Original buffers freed before total capacity sampling, so total pinned bytes were not measured.
